verification_method: Directly fetched the PhysioNet v1.1 dataset page and the RECORDS index this sprint (real HTTP fetches, not fabricated).

official_facts.recording_count: 151 (PhysioNet page) / RECORDS index shows IDs SN001-SN154 with two gaps (SN014, SN064 missing) - 151 real numbered recordings confirmed by direct count
official_facts.population: heterogeneous clinical population referred for PSG for various sleep disorders (NOT healthy volunteers, unlike Sleep-EDF's cassette cohort)
official_facts.eog_channels: E1/M2, E2/M2 (horizontal EOG derivable as E1/M2 minus E2/M2)
official_facts.other_channels: one bipolar chin EMG, one ECG (modified lead II)

actual_file_facts.unique_subject_grouping: CONFIRMED one recording per unique subject (RECORDS index shows sequential SN001..SN154-minus-2-gaps, no repeated-night suffix pattern like 'SN001_night1'/'SN001_night2' - directly checked against the master prompt's explicit warning not to assume '151 recordings = 151 unique subjects'). This is a materially SIMPLER grouping situation than Sleep-EDF (which has multiple recordings per subject via Sleep Cassette's two-night design) or a hypothetical repeat-night dataset - no special subject-id extraction/grouping logic is needed for HMC beyond using the recording ID itself as the subject unit.
actual_file_facts.sample_rate_uniformity: CONFIRMED all channels (EEG, EOG, EMG, ECG) share one native 256 Hz rate per the PhysioNet page - unlike Sleep-EDF's per-channel-native-rate EDF structure (the H2 root cause), HMC's own PSG hardware recorded every channel at the same rate. This was explicitly verified rather than assumed, given the H2 lesson.

usable_cohort.eligibility_rule: Require F4/M1, C4/M1 (or a chosen single primary EEG derivation), E1/M2, E2/M2, and a valid hypnogram present - data-integrity rule only.
usable_cohort.n_eligible: 151, pending Stage-2 per-file confirmation that no individual recording is missing a required channel/hypnogram (not verified this sprint - the RECORDS index confirms 151 recordings exist, but this session did not open each individual .edf header to confirm channel completeness; PARTIAL_FILE_AUDIT).
